evidence.quote: <action>Per D-04/D-12/D-13 and AC6 add cooperative mixin checks, only for participating configured views; super checks still run. Search current check IDs and allocate unused IDs in navbar.py, documenting them in tests; no global registry or forgotten-mixin check. Validate malformed configured declaration safely; unknown owner/child, nondirect child, absent explicit target key (including explicit list where only card exists), owner target lacking object, child target requiring object, duplicate owner keys, repeated child ViewSets even with distinct keys, every owner attachment with cv_object=False (list, card, create and custom no-object pages), and unrelated attachment. A target must both allow get in http_method_names and have a callable get method; include registered POST-only ActionView, GET-excluded and noncallable-get cases. Diagnostics name attachment class, navbar owner and item index/key; bar-level errors explicitly identify the bar rather than pretending an item exists. Check before render and do no database/access/state work. Tests invoke the actual Django/system-check pipeline with isolated registrations and verify zero queries and super-check retention. Addresses review concerns R8/R20 per D-13: in the existing check_viewsets entry point, call _url_configuration_loaded before starting ViewSet.checks_all, so URLconf imports finish before both the ViewSet registry snapshot and any live per-ViewSet view iteration. Extend that existing helper with keyword-only load=True, preserving current default behavior for ancestor checks. With load=False, traverse the same resolver tree and bounded seen set using only each resolver's already-cached __dict__["url_patterns"]; return false if any resolver lacks that cached property. Presence, not truthiness, determines readiness: an empty cached pattern list is complete. Never access uncached url_patterns or urlconf_module properties in this mode. Django URLResolver.url_patterns is a cached_property whose cache is written only after successful evaluation; inspect the installed supported source and test this dependency in the existing supported matrix. The navbar mixin locally imports the helper and calls only load=False during registry validation, so even a failed preflight cannot retry imports and mutate an active iterator. Keep all navbar-specific validation in navbar.py and preserve ViewSet iterators, base.py, ancestor policy, helper default behavior and request paths. Do not cache a completion flag, add context-local/global pass state, register another collector, or introduce a registry work queue. If readiness is false, defer owner/child/key/ancestry-dependent diagnostics only; preserve local declaration/attachment checks, then re-evaluate on a later completed check. Add a genuinely cold temporary ROOT_URLCONF/import fixture: pre-register one participating view on an existing ViewSet, then let URLconf import register multiple invalid configured views on that same ViewSet and another invalid configured view on a new ViewSet, with distinguishable attachment/item diagnostics. Call check_viewsets directly before any other registered check can warm the resolver and assert every late diagnostic in that first completed result; repeat through Django run_checks. A no-exception-only assertion is insufficient. Test a failed/in-progress preflight with an import-attempt counter proving no retry during iteration, preserved local errors, and successful later completion reporting all late registrations; also test an unloaded included URLconf, cached empty urlpatterns, early direct mixin checks, forward declarations, and a truly missing completed name. Restore the temporary modules, resolver caches and registry state in finally using Task01's isolation ordering. Addresses review concerns R10/R11/R14: validate nonempty configured NavBar.template using Django get_template and catch only TemplateDoesNotExist for a named startup diagnostic, following CheckTemplate semantics; None uses the default. Include valid custom template and missing-template cases. Pin NavItem() and empty supplied name/key as startup errors, empty items as a valid no-output bar, and card/custom owner no-object attachment failures. Wrong field types fail Pydantic construction; malformed cv_navbar attachment values fail safely at checks. No check performs database/access/state work.</action>
